## Annex3toFormofAgreement

## PriceAdjustment FormulasfortheBasicItems

increaseordecreaseofthefactorycementprice

- V2(EGP)=TheAdditional/DeductionValueduetotheincreaseordecreaseof the factory cement price.

## For Reinforced Concrete:

V2(EGP)=V1 X 0.35X [Cement new rate-Cement fixed rate].

## Where:

- V1(M3)=The totalquantitiesof theexecutedreinforcedConcreteaffected by the increaseor decreaseof thefactorycementprice
- the factory cement price.

## D. Reinforcement Steel Rebars

Incase the Reinforced Steel Bars factorypublishedprice of EZZ steel ex-factory (excluding VAT) for large customers became greater / less than EGP 33.500 (+/5%)as a Base Rate per ton, the following formula for calculating the additional / deduction value shall be applied within for the affected payment certificate(s) based onthefollowingconditions:

- The Contractor shall submit, for this specific month, the actual invoices, by the MaterialsInspection Requests.
- The increase or decrease in the price of steel reinforcement as produced by the approved supplier and as proofed by price quotations shall trigger the utilization of therelevantadjustmentformulae.
- the basis for calculating the actual quantities of Steel bars used (executed) during the month.

V2(EGP)=V1X [Steel new rate-steel fixed rate]

## Where:

- V1 (ton) = The total quantity of steel executed and certified by the Supervision Consultant.
- V2 (EGP)= The Additional/DeductionValue due to the increase or decrease of thefactorysteel Reinforcementprice
